summary: Klamath County lookout on the Fremont National Forest; listed only as 1930s and abandoned, and now gone. An Oregon directory lists Lookout Point under Lane, Multnomah and Yamhill counties, and none under Klamath County.

facts.status_note: Listed as abandoned with no date; no source says what, if anything, remains at the site.

evidence.supports: listed as gone; Klamath county column
Lookout Point listed under Lane County
Lookout Point listed under Multnomah County
Lookout Point listed under Yamhill County
the Yamhill Lookout Point entry is marked Removed
no Lookout Point entry under the Klamath County heading
directory includes entries named Lookout Point

notes_for_editor: Thin record: firelookout.com and the FFLA list agree on Klamath County and on 1930s/abandoned/gone. Verification on 2026-10-10 corrected an earlier claim: the Oregon Lookouts directory has no Lookout Point under Lake County. It lists Lookout Point under Lane, Multnomah and Yamhill counties (the Yamhill entry is marked Removed) and none under Klamath, so it does not point to a second Klamath site. Two web searches found no other description, dates or photos. The story is short because the evidence stops there.
